high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "spaceman.in." The post features a diagram illustrating the solar system with planets orbiting around the sun. The sun is depicted as a bright yellow-orange sphere at the center, surrounded by eight planets arranged in their respective orbits. The planets vary in size and color, representing different types such as gas giants (like Jupiter) and terrestrial planets (like Earth). The text on the image reads: "Planets orbit around the star..." with the word "star" highlighted in green.
